verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single passage saying customers are linked to accounts 'via Connect', a first-party account-linking flow. Nothing in the pack documents its hosted or drop-in nature, server-side session creation, widget embedding, or what is returned after linking. The token docs cover partner API access tokens, not a token for the connected account. missing for 10: documented server-side session/URL generation, hosted widget embedding SDK, returned connected-account token or ID, any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let a user connect their bank with a drop-in hosted flow — create a session server-side, open the widget, and get back a token for the connected account — without building institution UI myself

citations.quote: link them to at least one account via Connect
